title: stainless spreaders
text: stainless spreaders. I wanted some stainless spreaders for easy clean up via the dishwasher and these are perfect.  They are about 6" long.  Flat (not turned or bent like a traditional butter knife - which I am so happy about) and washed perfectly in the dishwasher.  They are also weighty.  I would buy them again - purchased 2 sets.
